difficulty_reason: The proof constructs a sequence of Neumann plumbing moves, separates string and node data, and controls definiteness through inverse forms and block linear algebra. It establishes equivalence of two topological plumbing classes, independently of the Seifert leading-q-exponent formula.

dedup.scope: Root complete DOI/arxiv2412.02042/title search across full corpus/preparation/production lines found no neighbors. Within this paper only canonical Seifert Delta formula and independent weak-versus-negative plumbing equivalence are counted. Restatement of the Seifert theorem in the introduction, examples, correction-term comparisons and direct special cases are uncounted.

compared.difference: Leading BPS q-exponent minimization for Seifert manifolds versus a constructive Neumann-calculus equivalence theorem for general weakly negative definite plumbings.
